name: DigitalTrialsID
description: Generate digital research participant ID cards for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet.

project-settings.name: Study Description
project-settings.description: Enter a lay-friendly description of the study purpose/objective.

project-settings.name: Contact Phone Number:
project-settings.description: This contact number is provided for situations in which a participant's healthcare provider needs to contact the study team.

project-settings.name: Instrument that issues Digital Study IDs

system-settings.name: Environment
system-settings.description: Identifies the environment used when generating wallet object IDs.

system-settings.name: Google Service Account Key (JSON)
system-settings.description: Paste the full contents of your Google Wallet service account JSON here.

system-settings.name: Google Issuer ID
system-settings.description: Your Google Wallet Issuer ID (for example, 3388000000022955593).

system-settings.name: Google Wallet Class ID Suffix
system-settings.description: Enter only the class suffix, for example digitaltrials_class. The issuer ID is added automatically.

system-settings.name: Apple Wallet Token Secret
system-settings.description: Shared secret used to sign Apple Wallet JWT tokens. Must match APPLE_TOKEN_SECRET in the Azure Function.

system-settings.name: Apple Wallet Endpoint URL
system-settings.description: Base URL for the Apple Wallet Azure Function.

system-settings.name: Logo URL
system-settings.description: Optional direct HTTPS URL to a logo image accessible by Google Wallet.

system-settings.name: Hero Image URL
system-settings.description: Optional direct HTTPS URL to a hero image accessible by Google Wallet.

system-settings.name: Card Background Color
system-settings.description: Enter a HEX color code for the background (for example, #004080).
